product_desc: marinated chicken wings in a clear vacuum pack, the meat deep orange-red and glossy through the plastic. Frame the meat only: the printed label, nutrition panel and barcode sit outside the shot, and no text of any kind appears in frame
cook: a young home cook in their late twenties, casual clothes, sleeves pushed up, relaxed and a little playful
kitchen: a bright modern apartment kitchen, pale counters, a small built-in oven, warm afternoon light from a window on the left, clean and uncluttered
prep_subject: marinated chicken wings laid out in a single layer on a foil-lined baking tray, each wing glossy with orange-red marinade, spaced so they do not touch. Beside the tray sit a small dish of white sesame seeds and a wedge of lemon. A pair of tongs rests flat at the far side of the tray
prep_defines: the wing spacing and the marinade coating
cook_vessel: a baking tray inside a lit oven
cook_subject: the wings partway through baking, the marinade darkened to a deep caramel red and beginning to blister at the edges, the skin tightening and rendering. Visible heat haze inside the oven, the tray sitting on the middle rack
cook_negatives: raw pale skin, burnt black wings, deep-fried batter, barbecue grill marks, sauce pooling on the tray
hero_subject: the finished wings piled on a round ceramic plate, skin glossy and caramelised, sprinkled with white sesame and chopped spring onion, a lemon wedge at the edge. A cold drink slightly out of focus behind
hero_setting: a small dining table in the same apartment, warm evening light
story: wings out of the bag and onto the tray
onto the plate, sesame scattered, one wing lifted
negatives_global: barbecue grill, deep-fried batter, western buffalo wings with blue cheese, raw pale skin, burnt black, canned sauce, restaurant kitchen, plastic bag, sealed packaging, product label, printed nutrition panel, barcode
first_heat: The wings settle across the tray in a single layer, the marinade already beginning to gloss and darken where it meets the hot surface, and a first thread of steam lifts from them.
transform: the marinade darkens from bright orange-red to deep caramel, the skin tightens and starts to blister at the edges, and rendered fat pools and bubbles gently around each wing.
lift: A pair of tongs enters from the left, closes on one wing, lifts it clear of the tray and holds it at the centre of frame. The skin is glossy and caramelised, and a single drop of glaze runs from the tip.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the tray, tip it once over the plate, and the wings slide out and settle in a pile. The hands withdraw straight up out of frame with the empty tray.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right, takes one wing between finger and thumb, lifts it clear of the plate and holds it steady at the centre of frame, a thread of glaze running from it.
sound_01: A quiet apartment kitchen with a low room tone. In the first shot, the soft slide of a ceramic bowl across a counter. In the second shot, the light wet sound of marinated wings being gathered. In the third shot, an oven door opening, a warm rush of air, and the tray settling onto the rack. No speech, no music from within the room.
sound_02: A low oven hum throughout. In the first shot, the tray shifting on the rack. In the second shot, fat rendering and popping quietly as the marinade caramelises. In the third shot, tongs clicking closed and a single drop of glaze falling back onto the tray. No speech.
sound_03: A quiet apartment with a low room tone. In the first shot, wings sliding from a metal tray onto a ceramic plate. In the second shot, the light patter of sesame seeds landing. In the third shot, the small sound of a wing lifted from a plate, and a drink glass settling on wood. No speech.
music: A relaxed lo-fi bed: soft drums under an electric piano figure and a light bass, unhurried and easy, the mood of a Friday evening at home.
